The sample sent with a certification request must be taken only after the batch has been thoroughly mixed to ensure uniform composition throughout [2], and must be held under the control of the person requesting certification until certified [3]. The sample must be labeled to show: (1) the name of the color additive [5], (2) the manufacturer's batch number [6], (3) the quantity of such batch [7], (4) the name and post-office address of the person requesting certification of such batch [8], and (5) be accompanied by any label or labeling intended to be used [9].

The name of the color additive is required and must be shown on the sample label [5].  
The manufacturer's batch number is required and must be shown on the sample label [6].  
The quantity of such batch is required and must be shown on the sample label [7].  
The name and post-office address of the person requesting certification are required and must be shown on the sample label [8].  
Any label or labeling intended to be used must accompany the sample [9].  

The requirement that the batch be thoroughly mixed prior to sampling applies only if the batch has been properly mixed [2]. The sample must remain under the control of the requester until certification is issued [3].
